import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

def get_left (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ l _ => some l
  | _ => none

def get_right (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ r => some r
  | _ => none

def get_val (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v _ _ => some v
  | _ => none

def BinarySearchTree.is_node (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zig_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t ∧ 
  BinarySearchTree.is_node t ∧ 
  (match get_left t with | some l => BinarySearchTree.is_node l | none => False)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def zigAux : BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
| BinarySearchTree.Node v (BinarySearchTree.Node lv ll lr) r =>
    BinarySearchTree.Node lv ll (BinarySearchTree.Node v lr r)
| t => t
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def zig (t : BinarySearchTree) 
    (h_precond : zig_precond t) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  zigAux t
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zig_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : zig_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∧
  -- Structural properties
  get_val result = get_val (get_left t).get! ∧
  BinarySearchTree.is_node (get_right result).get! ∧
  get_val (get_right result).get! = get_val t
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem zig_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree)
    (h_precond : zig_precond t) :
    zig_postcond t (zig t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  revert h_precond
  cases t with
  | Empty =>
    intro h
    exact ((h.2.1 : False)).elim
  | Node v l r =>
    cases l with
    | Empty =>
      intro h
      exact ((h.2.2 : False)).elim
    | Node lv ll lr =>
      intro h
      have hA : ∀ x ∈ view (BinarySearchTree.Node lv ll lr), x < v := h.1.1
      have h1 : ∀ x ∈ view ll, x < lv := h.1.2.1.1
      have h2 : is_bst ll := h.1.2.1.2.1
      have h3 : ∀ x ∈ view lr, x > lv := h.1.2.1.2.2.1
      have h4 : is_bst lr := h.1.2.1.2.2.2
      have hB : ∀ x ∈ view r, x > v := h.1.2.2.1
      have hr : is_bst r := h.1.2.2.2
      have hlv : lv < v := hA lv (by simp [view])
      have hlrv : ∀ x ∈ view lr, x < v := by
        intro x hx
        exact hA x (by simp [view]; tauto)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node lv ll (BinarySearchTree.Node v lr r))
        refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_, ⟨hlrv, h4, hB, hr⟩⟩
        intro x hx
        have hx' : x ∈ view lr ∨ x ∈ view r ∨ x = v := by
          simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
          tauto
        rcases hx' with hx1 | hx1 | hx1
        · exact h3 x hx1
        · exact lt_trans hlv (hB x hx1)
        · exact hx1 ▸ hlv
      · show view (BinarySearchTree.Node lv ll (BinarySearchTree.Node v lr r))
            = view (BinarySearchTree.Node v (BinarySearchTree.Node lv ll lr) r)
        ext x
        simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        tauto
      · rfl
      · trivial
      · rfl
  -- !benchmark @end proof

  match t with
